subject: general
question: A farmer borrowed ₹10,500 from a village cooperative at 7% simple interest per annum. After 2 years, he repaid the amount along with a processing fee of ₹525. Find the total amount he paid back.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Simple Interest % = Rate × Time = 7% × 2 = 14%

Interest amount = 14% of ₹10,500 = 14 × 105 = ₹1,470

Total amount to repay = Principal + Interest + Processing Fee

Total amount = ₹10,500 + ₹1,470 + ₹525 = ₹12,495

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12,495.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹10,500

Rate (R) = 7% p.a.

Time (T) = 2 years

Processing Fee = ₹525

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Total Amount = Principal + SI + Other Fees

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/042a57e14567317d7af53518b6ba817ccdf97e8ae4f2d0d3f9c52090668035b1.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = (10500 × 7 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 105 × 14

⇒ SI = ₹1,470

⇒ Repayment Amount = Principal + SI

⇒ Repayment Amount = ₹10,500 + ₹1,470 = ₹11,970

⇒ Total Payment including Fee = ₹11,970 + ₹525

⇒ Total Payment = ₹12,495

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12,495.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Repayment with Extra Charges

Total Payback = P + (P × R × T)/100 + Service Charges. Extra fees are always added to the final amount.

Effective Rate of Simple Interest

The total percentage of interest accrued is R × T. Amount becomes (100 + RT)% of the principal.

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

For 2 years, the difference between CI and SI is P(R/100)². In SI, interest is only calculated on the principal.
